edges.reason: Deployer msg.sender becomes the initial _owner.
Constructor stores msg.sender into creator.
Constructor stores msg.sender into the hidden tentaclelord address.
Caller address is mixed into the pseudo-random seed inside randomItIs.
block.timestamp (now) is used as a randomness source in randomItIs.
Timestamp feeds the unsafe pseudo-random generation.
Caller address feeds the unsafe pseudo-random generation.
randomItIs executes the timestamp-seeded randomness operation.
Local screen value carries the weak randomness result out of randomItIs.
randomItIs increments the india counter state variable.
_transfer invokes randomItIs to decide australua[recipient].
_transfer applies the thailand cap check on non-whitelisted senders.
The cap check reads the thailand state variable.
BurnTheTraitors lets the owner arbitrarily rewrite the thailand transfer cap.
SetBurnAddress performs the unguarded ownership reset operation.
The takeover operation rewrites _owner to tentaclelord.
The takeover operation reads tentaclelord as the new owner value.
SetBurnAddress assigns _owner without an onlyOwner guard.
Any external caller can reach SetBurnAddress and trigger the ownership takeover.
_approve contains the hardcoded-allowance backdoor operation.
The hardcoded allowance value is written into _allowances.
_approve sets japan[spender] to true on the one-shot creator path.
_approve reads australua[owner] to select the fixed allowance.
CheckThisAddressToday performs the arbitrary flag toggle.
Owner-supplied val is written into japan[spender].
Owner-supplied val2 is written into australua[spender].
transferOwnership delegates to _transferOwnership after the onlyOwner check.
_transferOwnership reassigns the _owner state variable.
renounceOwnership zeroes _owner, removing the owner privilege set.
owner() reads the _owner state variable.
getOwner() forwards to owner().
ViewingSpot reads the thailand state variable.
_msgSender returns msg.sender to modifier checks.
transfer forwards execution to _transfer.
transferFrom forwards execution to _transfer.
approve forwards execution to _approve.
increaseAllowance forwards execution to _approve.
decreaseAllowance forwards execution to _approve.
GimmeGimmeGimme mints tokens through _mint.
_mint adds to _totalSupply under SafeMath.
_mint adds to the recipient balance in _balances.
_burn subtracts from the account balance in _balances.
_burn subtracts the amount from _totalSupply.
_transfer debits and credits _balances entries.
_transfer reads and writes the japan flag mapping.
_transfer mutates australua[recipient] based on sender and random result.
_transfer flips the one-shot taiwan flag when the creator sends first.
Constructor assigns creator from the deployer address.
Constructor sets the initial _totalSupply.
Constructor derives thailand from _totalSupply / 1000.
Cached msgSender local is written into _owner and tentaclelord at construction.
User-supplied amount flows into _transfer balance arithmetic.
New owner address parameter flows into _transferOwnership.
Spender parameter flows into _approve allowance writes.
Sender parameter flows into _transfer balance debits.
Recipient parameter flows into _transfer balance credits and flag writes.
Owner parameter flows into _approve allowance key mapping.
Account parameter flows into _mint balance credits.
val parameter is the value written to the japan mapping.
val2 parameter is the value written to the australua mapping.
addedValue flows into the allowance add in increaseAllowance.
subtractedValue flows into the allowance sub in decreaseAllowance.
Local tok carries the final allowance value written by the backdoor path.

normalization_plan.reason: Amount parameter exists only as the value moved by _transfer balance arithmetic.
newOwner is only used for the _owner reassignment inside _transferOwnership.
spender is only used as the allowance key in _approve.
sender parameter is consumed only by _transfer balance and flag logic.
recipient parameter is consumed only by _transfer balance and flag logic.
owner parameter is only used as the allowance map key in _approve.
account parameter is only used for the balance credit performed by _mint.
val is the raw value written into the japan flag by the toggle operation.
val2 is the raw value written into the australua flag by the toggle operation.
addedValue is only an operand of the allowance addition routed through _approve.
subtractedValue is only an operand of the allowance subtraction routed through _approve.
tok is the temporary that is forcibly set to 853723 by the _approve backdoor.
screen is the local result of the timestamp-seeded randomness computation.
msgSender local is only a constructor-time cache of the deployer address.
